messages:
anya (design): sharing the latest mock for the model catalog compare/table — trying a tighter row density to fit more rows but worried about scanability. link: https://img.redwood.dev/s/compare-v5.png

sam (design): nice — can you annotate which rows are priority? density is fine for power users but first-time users may miss perf badges.

mike (product): biggest thing for me is discoverability of pinned versions. if pins are subtle they get overlooked during rollouts. also +1 to clearer badge semantics (perf vs stability).

olivia (eng): technical note: if we increase density we'll need to tweak keyboard focus hit targets. currently we rely on 32px rows; shrinking to 24px may break tab navigation on mobile.

lucas (a11y): agree with olivia. also contrast on the light-gray badge background drops below AA at 24px font. we should keep badges >3:1 contrast or use bordered tokens.

anya (design): thoughts on making pins more prominent without increasing visual noise? idea: show a small vertical pin icon + subtle chip that expands on hover to read "pinned v3.2".

sam (design): can we also make the badge clickable to open a lightweight details flyout rather than navigate away? keeps context during compares.

mike (product): that would help. Product ask: can the flyout include last rollout date and a quick rollback button (disabled unless user has perms)?

olivia (eng): flyout is fine. for the row density change i propose: keep default density compact but add a user toggle in the header labelled "Compact rows" so people opt-in. fallback: remember preference per user.

lucas (a11y): if it's optional, remember to persist preference with an accessible label and a screen-reader only description: aria-describedby="density-desc" with text 'Toggle compact rows to fit more items; changes layout and focus targets'.

anya (design): thanks, lucas — can you paste the exact aria copy we should use?

lucas (a11y): sure — aria-label="Compact rows" aria-describedby="density-desc". density-desc text: "When enabled, reduces row height to show more models. Keyboard focus areas increase; ensure you confirm changes."

olivia (eng): quick CSS note for focus ring if we reduce height: use outline: 2px solid var(--focus) and padding: 6px; avoid relying solely on box-shadow.

product-bot: created ticket UI-1287: "Catalog: compact density opt-in + pin flyout + a11y fixes" and assigned to @sam (design), @olivia (eng), @lucas (a11y).

mike (product): small copy tweak: for the pin chip text prefer "Pinned — v3.2" instead of just version number. clearer at a glance.

anya (design): will update mocks with pinned chip expanded state and add hover flyout. i'll keep row toggle in header and persistence note.

sam (design): i'll prototype the chip interaction and post an interactive gif.

olivia (eng): once we have prototype i'll run a quick perf check for row render cost (virtualized list should be fine but want numbers).

lucas (a11y): i'll do a 5-min screen-reader pass on the prototype and share findings.

anya (design): thanks all — next step: i'll upload updated artboards by EOD and link the ticket. please add any blocking concerns to the ticket comments. :thumbsup:
